entities.summary: Sihanouk, a notable figure in the history of Cambodia, associated with French Colonial Period (1940–1953). Preceded by Royal Crusade and Geneva Accord. Their legacy influenced King Norodom Sihanouk achieves full independence through his 'Royal Crusade' and Sihanouk abdicates and creates the Sangkum Reastr Niyum movement.
